evidence.source: Main paper, crystal-structure deposition statement: CCDC 2499860/2499861/2499862 identify the 3-Cl, 3-I and 3-Br crystals.
Main paper, computational approach: periodic PAW/HSE06 calculations, SCF convergence and Gamma-centered sampling.
Main paper, computational approach: band path and 50 points per segment generated with VASPKIT.
Main paper, electronic-structure results: Cl primary allowed excitation/gap is 4.63 eV and the structural trend is discussed.
Main paper, electronic-structure results: Br primary allowed excitation/gap is 4.64 eV.
Main paper, electronic-structure results: I primary allowed excitation/gap is 4.44 eV.
Main paper, SOC/model discussion: model SOC shrinkage and resulting values are trend estimates, not accurate parent-cell values.

Main paper pp2,4-5: HSE06 context, organic pi-star levels versus higher Pb-related excitation energies, separate reduced-model SOC estimate. Approved observable split; evaluation/boundary_repair_evidence.json replays original group_6 EIGENVAL in both successful meshes. Historical analyze_hse06_band_edges.py selected vband+9 and minimized same-k differences; this does not establish the global independent-edge gap, full-zone directness, exhaustive manifold assignment or optical allowedness. Raw projection outputs remain available, not rewritten or used as an agent answer. Current update: evaluation/verification_supplement.json closes the original second-grid identity gap using independent new projections; the boundary_repair_evidence.json release_reconciliation is retained as historical provenance.

Evaluator-private evaluation/verification_supplement.json and verified_computation_reference.md: three independently projected 3x3x1 HSE06 SCFs completed 2026-09-16, re-extracted from raw outputs 2026-09-20; same-object character, four distinct observables and cross-mesh stability established within sampled domain.
